    SELECT f.fac_key,
           COUNT(*) as total_outcomes,
           SUM(CASE WHEN (o.txprogmet->>'Tx_Adh') IN ('High', 'Medium', 'Compliant') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as adherent_outcomes,
           ROUND(1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN (o.txprogmet->>'Tx_Adh') IN ('High', 'Medium', 'Compliant') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) as tar_rate
    FROM facilities f
    JOIN clinicians c ON f.fac_key = c.fac_connect
    JOIN patients p ON p.clin_lead_ref = c.clin_key
    JOIN encounters e ON e.pat_ref = p.pat_key
    JOIN treatmentbasics t ON t.enc_ref = e.enc_key
    JOIN treatmentoutcomes o ON o.tx_ref = t.tx_key
    GROUP BY f.fac_key
)

FROM facility_resources fr
JOIN facility_tar ft ON fr.fac_key = ft.fac_key
ORDER BY fr.fac_key
LIMIT 20;
